info.description:
HL7 FHIR API for Practitioner resource. 
Supported profiles - 
[http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner,
http://hl7.org/fhir/us/carin-bb/StructureDefinition/C4BB-Practitioner]
info.title: Practitioner

get.description: Search for Practitioner resources. Since this API supports multiple HL7 profiles, if you do not provide a value for `_profile` a default value of `http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner` will be used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
A server defined search that may match any of the string fields
in the `HumanName`, including `family`, `give`, `prefix`, `suffix`, and/or
`text` (Select Practitioners with the specified name (matches against any
of the elements in the HumanName data type)). 
Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner]

parameters.name: given
parameters.description: A portion of the given name (Select Practitioners with the specified given name). Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner]

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: A portion of the family name (Select Practitioners with the specified family name). Supported profiles - [http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner]

parameters.name: _profile
parameters.description:
Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.
default value: `http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/StructureDefinition/plannet-Practitioner`

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

parameters.name: _lastUpdated
parameters.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`
